SPY.title: Rand Paul Slams '$1-2 Billion-A-Day Iran War:' 'Debt Is Our National Security Crisis'
SPY.description: Senator Rand Paul opposes additional military funding for the Iran war, citing the $1-2 billion daily cost and arguing that the national debt poses a greater security threat than foreign adversaries. Paul criticizes the Trump administration's fiscal policies, including tariffs and bailouts, all funded through borrowing. He joins lawmakers like Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders in opposing the supplemental war requests estimated at $50-200 billion.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
